description: Read-only, parameterized query over the Tensorust Ontology (no query language, nothing to inject). Search mode: filter objects by name (match contains | prefix | exact), type (Organization, ControlGroup, FCCLicense, Sanction, PAC, Rule), rule (objects a federal rule applies to: ROAD-1001, DFARS-FOCI, FCC-FAC, FCC-FAC-FLAG, CBAND-LUMP, ERATE-LATEINV, OFAC-SDN) with an optional rule status, min_sources (objects found in N+ public data sources) and min_links; sort by relevance, sources, links or name; returns total, a page of rows {oid, name, type, sources, links, status} and next_offset. Graph mode: from=<oid> lists that object's links with counts; add link (OWNS, HOLDS, RECEIVED, MEMBER_OF, SUBSIDIARY_OF, SUBJECT_TO, APPLIED, SERVES, BORROWS, LENDS_TO, SANCTIONED, LOBBIES_FOR, HAS_PAC, FILED) and direction (out | in) to page the linked objects. Pages are 10 rows by default, 25 max (100 with a Tensorust key). Errors say exactly which value to send. Call describe_schema first if unsure. Free.

direction.description: Graph mode: out = this object -> others (default); in = others -> this object (e.g. subsidiaries of a parent: link SUBSIDIARY_OF, direction in).

from.description: Graph mode: an object id from a search row, e.g. 'org:LOCKHEED MARTIN', 'cg:632693'.

limit.description: Rows per page, default 10; max 25 without a key, 100 with one.

link.description: Graph mode: which link to list.

min_links.description: Only objects with at least this many links.

min_sources.description: Only objects present in at least this many public data sources (cross-source entities are the best-resolved).

name.description: Text to match on object names; case and punctuation are ignored. e.g. 'blackstone', 'Lockheed Martin'

offset.description: Paging offset from next_offset. The free tier sees the first 100 matches (25 for a rule list, 10 linked objects).

rule.description: Only objects this federal rule applies to (call describe_schema for each rule's meaning and statuses).

sort.description: Default relevance: exact name matches first, then by sources and links.

status.description: With rule: one of that rule's statuses, e.g. 'applies', 'listed', 'likely', 'action_by_2026-11-12'.

name: query_ontology
title: Query the ontology (search or graph)
